    A source-independent coend boundary for the BGRS critical diagrams #

    This file extracts the part of the closed-chain/Figure-16 argument which does not depend on the shape of the finite source. A CleavingSourceFamily is an explicit countable family of finite-dimensional, indecomposable, pairwise-nonisomorphic source modules with local endomorphism rings. A Hom-bifunctor retraction for a realization of that source in the primitive projectives then produces an infinite family over the ambient algebra by the cross-universe coend construction.

    The point of the interface is that the callbacks which remain in Figures 14 and 15 are literal cleaving (Hom-bifunctor retraction) callbacks. No representation-infinite conclusion is assumed in the package.
